summary: Frontend-only verification of three UI fixes: ScrollToTop on route change, header 'Quick Order' button replacing WhatsApp button, and Products dropdown listing main categories with subcategories (both desktop and mobile). All checks passed.

issues: A11y console warning: DialogContent missing DialogTitle/Description (not blocking, but worth adding VisuallyHidden title)

critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx: consider hiding main-category headings that have zero subcategories to avoid empty 'Small Animal'/'Poultry' groups in the desktop dropdown (currently shown as bare headings).
SearchModal DialogContent should include a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle for a11y (Radix warning in console).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on preview URL. Desktop: whatsapp-order-btn absent, quick-order-btn present and navigates to /quick-order; nav-quick-order absent. Products dropdown shows nav-cat-large-animal/small-animal/poultry with subs nav-subcat-tonics-supplements/antibiotics/mastitis-care and All Products link; clicking sub navigates to /categories/<slug>. ScrollToTop works: after scrolling /products to bottom and opening a product, window.scrollY=0 on detail page; /news also loads at scrollY=0. Mobile hamburger menu lists main categories with indented subcategories.
